requirements.requirement: Create a local account named opsadmin on node1.
requirements.summary: opsadmin was initially absent, then directly observed in /etc/passwd with UID/GID 1000 and remained present after restart.

requirements.requirement: Give opsadmin a private home directory.
requirements.summary: /home/opsadmin was directly observed before and after restart with owner opsadmin:opsadmin and mode 0700.
opsadmin belonged to wheel, sudo policy allowed (ALL) ALL, and password-authenticated sudo successfully asserted UID 0 before and after restart.

overall_summary: All material outcomes are satisfied. The mandatory node-restart evidence is also complete: node1 was healthy before restart, acknowledged the restart, became temporarily unreachable, returned with a different boot ID, and recovered its system, sshd, account, home, and administrative behavior. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently match the executor's pre- and post-restart observations.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified; therefore none remained or required reversion. Account creation, permissions, group membership, and password setup were task-related; subsequent password rotations directly enabled bounded sudo behavior checks. The transient reboot unit and restart were required by the provider evidence protocol. Final observations showed no failed services, no added listening endpoints, healthy package state, and only expected boot-scoped temporary-file turnover.
